verdict.rationale: Puzzle advertises an API (puzzle-docs-1) and an MCP integration for agents (puzzle-docs-2), plus a natural-language 'ask anything about your business' feature that matches the 'can we afford X' pattern (puzzle-docs-9, puzzle-docs-16). However, there's no hands-on evidence of an agent actually querying live ledger data via the API, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec, so the depth/reliability of API-grounded Q&A is unverified.
